items.notes: Created meta/main.yml with role metadata including platforms, tags, and dependencies.
Created main.yml task file that conditionally includes either deploy_automate.yml or deploy_chef_server.yml based on variables.
Created defaults/main.yml with variables for Chef deployment including hostname, user details, organization details, and deployment type flags.
Created README.md with comprehensive documentation including role variables, examples, and deployment options.

items.description: Script for deploying Chef Automate and Chef Infra Server
items.notes: Created deploy_automate.yml with tasks to set hostname, configure sysctl parameters, download and deploy Chef Automate with Infra Server, and create Chef user and organization.

items.description: Script for deploying only Chef Infra Server
items.notes: Created deploy_chef_server.yml with tasks to set hostname, configure sysctl parameters, download and deploy Chef Infra Server only, and create Chef user and organization.
Created defaults/main.yml with variables for Chef deployment including hostname, user details, organization details, and deployment type flags.
Created empty handlers/main.yml file as no handlers are needed for this role.
Created empty vars/main.yml file as no additional variables are needed for this role.
Created requirements.yml with ansible.posix collection dependency for sysctl module.
